info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Meetings Meetings Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Meeting Cancellation API allows users to remove scheduled meetings from the system efficiently. By leveraging this endpoint, organizations can maintain accurate scheduling and resource management by canceling meetings that are no longer necessary. This functionality is essential for administrative users and applications that automate meeting management processes. Typical consumers include calendar applications, administrative dashboards, and team collaboration tools that require real-time updates to meeting statuses.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a scheduled meeting by providing the meeting ID. Successfully canceling a meeting will remove it from the calendar, and the participants will be notified accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary details to cancel a meeting. Ensure that you provide the correct meeting identifier to successfully perform the cancellation.

202.description: The request to cancel the meeting has been accepted and is being processed.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelRequest.description: A string representing the request body for canceling a meeting operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result from the operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

DeleteMeetingsMeetingsCancelResponse_202.description: Response schema for the cancel operation of meetings.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the operation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A value of 0 indicates that the processing time was negligible.
